business.name: Four Points by Sheraton French Quarter

ranking.name: Four Points by Sheraton French Quarter

text.text_excerpt: I was pleased with my first stay here this past week. The whole hotel has been remodeled (still ongoing) and my room was clean and comfortable. The bed was perfect. The bathroom, though small, was clean. Overall, the rooms are decent-sized. The Bourbon Street balcony that I shared with 2 other rooms was great! One of the best perks of staying here are the Bourbon St balconies. The lobby is nice! The pool (though closed) looked appealing. The pool area was beautiful with lots of tables and lounge chairs. The restaurant is pretty big for a hotel restaurant. The staff was wonderful. Some of them have been there 15+ years which says a lot about how they are treated here. Most of the employees...

This Four Points is a nice hotel, with some caveats. First, don't stay ON BOURBON STREET and bitch about noise. Bourbon Street IS noise - if that's a problem, stay someplace else. I hear Metairie is nice. Now, on to the particulars. It's an old building so expect smaller than average rooms with the dreaded interconnecting doors that amplify sounds. The bathrooms are TINY. It helps if you pretend you're in France (instead of the French Quarter) and you'll be much happier with the room size. Everything was very clean in our room but they are not doing daily housekeeping right now. We were on the top (5th floor) so street noise wasn't too bad but we did have leaky windows/some water damage. ...

This hotel has a great location just two blocks away from Pat O'Briens...right in the "hot zone" on Bourbon. They have balcony suites, garden suites, and suites that are on Bourbon with a balcony shared with other guests' rooms. The rooms are comfortable (double beds are a bit small). Housekeeping was a bit erratic - had to ask for towels and service from time to time even though they were knocking on the door every morning at 9 (ow my aching head). I also did not appreciate the street show that happened 3 times per day in front of our balcony.
